title: Shorts from a long talking video (pick and reframe to 9:16)
what_it_does: Proposes 15-45 s segments made of whole sentences with a hook in the first 2 s (a question, a number, a hook word or a short opener), then cuts one and reframes it to 1080x1920 (centre crop, optional --face-x, or a blurred-background fit) with its own word file for captions.
when_to_use: When a long recording should also give Reels/Shorts. The picker proposes; the agent reads the text and the person chooses. For a speaker who moves, run subject-track once and pass --track (a moving crop plus a face-safe text band); otherwise pass --face-x.
notes: Own code. Whole-sentence ranking follows the idea of digitalsamba/claude-code-video-toolkit's highlights.py (MIT); nothing is copied. End-to-end proof: catalog/lanes/talking-head/example/run-proof.sh.
